ValidationRule.description: Agents must have Agent Tier, Account Industry. BOPI-460 Updated to ignore CPQ opps and System users
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", RecordType.Name = 'Agents', Pricebook2.Name <> 'CPQ', Probability > 0.90, OR( Account.Revenue_Share_Agreement__c = TRUE, Contract_Not_Required__c = False), OR ( ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.Agent_Tier__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.Account_Industry__c)), ContractId = "", ISBLANK(Contract.ActivatedDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(Contract.Flywire_Entity__c)), ISBLANK(Contract.StartDate), ISBLANK(Contract.EndDate) ) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must Fill in: On Account - Agent Tier and Account Industry. On Contract - Flywire Entity, Start and End date. Contract must be activated. If Contract is not Required check *Contract Not Required*.
